name: risk.thresholds

purpose: Inspect risk event thresholds through their native inquiry without changing configuration.

fields.name: benchmarkId
fields.meaning: Native record identity; original JSON type is retained.

fields.name: gmtModified
fields.meaning: Native modification timestamp; no timezone conversion.

identity_description: Native benchmarkId identifies each record; no synthetic identity is created.
limitations: Fixed native pageSize=10; rowStart offsets start at zero.
Native endpoint has no page echoes. Completeness requires fixed total, arrival and unique identity agreement.
Unknown fields, native JSON types and exact decimal values are retained.
Pinned v0.4.3 provides contract provenance; current production qualification is recorded separately.
Native detail uses POST form /api/risk/benchmark/riskEventBenchmarkDetailDetail.json; sends benchmarkId as a string without tenant or timeZone.
Detail returns one native root response; separate histories, logs and child pages are not queried.

List with --live --with-detail fetches detail only for the selected offset/limit window as separate record/detail members; any detail failure fails the whole query. Get and combined queries preserve the saved List.
